title: Plantation blues and railroad songs
summary: He says blues came from railroad workers, with Frankie and Johnny and Stack-o-Lee as the first things he played on guitar.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues

blocks.x: I was wondering I keep bothering about that early music on the plantation and all did they have any blues singers in those days? sing any blues?

quite a bit that's where it came from railroad songs always they sing the blues as long as I can remember that Frank and Johnny came out when I was a boy you ever heard Frank and Johnny? what about the in the good old summer times you remember Stackele blues? that's the first thing I played on the guitar
was Stackele a real person? do you remember anything about that story?

no only I know that's the blues it came right off the railroad cause a lot of the railroad folks that's all they could play on the guitar and that's why I learned it on my guitar the first thing I learned to pick on the guitar was Stackele
did they sing those blues while they were working?
yes, wiking and singing railroad men wiking and singing
